findings: CRA Annex I Part I (2)(i) was misquoted; permanent user deletion is (2)(m)
IEC 62443-4-2 CR 4.1 is Information confidentiality; CR 4.2 is Information persistence; CR 4.3 is Use of cryptography
NIST SP 800-88 Rev.1 withdrawn 2025-09-26 and superseded by Rev.2
multi-pass overwrite for flash is not a generally valid recommendation
hardware/firmware and cryptographic erase were overstated as mandatory CRA implementation
Article 13(8) concerns vulnerability handling and support period, not update-free/separate quote
minimum five-year support period is legal baseline with expected-use-time exception
Annex I Part II (2) requires separate security updates where technically feasible
Annex I Part II (8) provides free updates subject to tailored business-user agreement exception
Article 13(9) requires update availability for at least 10 years or remaining support period, whichever longer
Annex I Part II (4) disclosure elements do not mandate CVE ID or CSAF format
automatic rollback and safe state are product risk-engineering recommendations, not universal CRA prescriptions
IEC 62443-4-1 Practice 7 mapping is topical; detailed conformity requires licensed standard text
Article 11 is General product safety, not CVD
Article 14 title is Reporting obligations of manufacturers
original Article 11 quotation is not official regulation text
CVD basis is Article 13(8)/(17), Annex I Part II (5)/(6), Annex II (2)
actively exploited vulnerability timeline 24h/72h/14 days after corrective measure available
severe incident timeline 24h/72h/one month after incident notification
Article 14 reports through ENISA single platform to coordinating CSIRT and ENISA
Article 14 applies from 2026-09-11; transitional Article 69(3) applies to earlier products in scope
Annex II is user information; Annex VII is technical documentation
Article 11 is General product safety; manufacturer obligations are Article 13
Article 13(8) is support period, not free update wording
Annex I Part II (8) is free security updates subject to tailored business-user agreement exception
CVD is Annex I Part II (5)/(6) and Article 13(17)/Annex II (2)
secure update distribution is Annex I Part II (7)
digital signature and STO update procedure are not specific universal implementation requirements
Annex I Part I product properties and Part II vulnerability handling are distinct
